# StackKit Metadata and Mode Configuration
apiVersion: stackkit/v1
kind: StackKit

metadata:
  name: basement-kit
  displayName: "Basement Kit"
  version: "5.1.0"
  description: "Local-first StackKit for one or more nodes on private home sites"
  author: "kombify Stack Team"
  license: "Apache-2.0"
  # Generated by scripts/derive-status-surfaces.mjs from basement-kit/mode_matrix.cue.
  # Standard default: placement.standard=scaffolding; receipts=none
  # Standard default: install.bootstrapped=scaffolding; receipts=none
  maturity: alpha
  repository: "https://github.com/kombifyio/stackkits"
  tags:
    - homelab
    - single-environment
    - multi-server-capable
    - docker
    - coolify
    - komodo
    - professional

# Supported operating systems
supportedOS:
  - ubuntu-26
  - ubuntu-24
  - ubuntu-22
  - debian-12

# Resource requirements: minimum is the low compute graph in stackfile.cue
# (standalone core, Photos Lite); the standard kit floor is 2 CPU / 4 GB /
# 20 GB. Recommended matches the stackfile recommendation.
requirements:
  minimum:
    cpu: 2
    memory: 2
    disk: 10
  recommended:
    cpu: 4
    memory: 4
    disk: 20

# =============================================================================
# INSTALLATION MODES (Available for all StackKits)
# =============================================================================
modes:
  bare:
    description: "OpenTofu-only deployment without Base Hub or setup automation"
    templateDir: "templates/simple"
    engine: "opentofu"
    features:
      - "Direct OpenTofu execution"
      - "No Base Hub UI"
      - "Manual application setup"
    recommended_for:
      - "Operators who only want generated infrastructure and tool rollouts"

  bootstrapped:
    description: "Default Base Hub rollout with one-click setup actions"
    templateDir: "templates/simple"
    engine: "opentofu"
    recommended: true
    features:
      - "Base Hub and node-local API"
      - "Automatic L1/L2 setup"
      - "On-demand L3 setup actions"
    recommended_for:
      - "Single node deployments"
      - "Guided setup without automatic L3 preconfiguration"
      - "Development, testing, and normal homelab rollouts"

  # Advanced Mode: Terramate Plus lifecycle with runtime and frontend
  # intelligence. Release readiness is still tracked separately in the
  # mode-support matrix until the full E2E cell lands.
  advanced:
    description: "Advanced lifecycle rollout with Terramate Plus orchestration"
    templateDir: "templates/advanced"
    engine: "terramate"
    features:
      - "Terramate Plus orchestration"
      - "Runtime Intelligence Layer"
      - "Frontend Intelligence surfaces"
      - "Advanced bootstrap and service handoff policies"
      - "Drift detection, change sets, rollback, and restore drills"
      - "Komodo/Coolify platform adapters"
      - "Managed TechStack lifecycle handoff"
    recommended_for:
      - "Production environments"
      - "Compliance requirements"
      - "Multi-stack coordination"
    stacks:
      - name: foundation
        order: 1
        description: "StackKit-owned foundation services"
      - name: platform
        order: 2
        after: [foundation]
        description: "Selected PaaS controller and routing"
      - name: applications
        order: 3
        after: [platform]
        description: "User applications via selected PaaS"

# Auto-selection rules
autoSelect:
  advancedWhen:
    - "explicit advanced install mode"
    - "autoUpdates.enabled == true"
    - "compliance.required == true"
  default: bootstrapped

# =============================================================================
# APPLICATION LAYER (L3 — use cases)
# =============================================================================
# Canonical layer name per ADR-0012 sk_layer + ARCHITECTURE_V6 §4. Pre-2026-04
# this section was called `useCases`; renamed to `application` to match the
# Foundation / Platform / Application standard surfaced in the Admin UI.
#
# Role: default = ships enabled, alternative = curated swap, optional = user enables.
# CUE/StackKit contracts are the rollout source of truth; the Admin registry mirrors release lineage and operations state.
application:
  photos:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists photos optional with empty defaults; SK-S1 enables it via --use-case.
    package: photos
    defaultTool: immich
    alternatives: []
    description: "Photo gallery and memories"
    defaultRuntimeProfile: self-hosted-photos
    runtimeProfiles:
      self-hosted-photos:
        displayName: "Self-hosted Photo Vault"
        realization: oss
        placementModes: [local-only, standard]
        description: "Digest-pinned Immich through the graph-selected runtime: PaaS on standard/high, standalone lite on low."
      bring-your-own-photos:
        displayName: "Bring Your Own Photo Service"
        realization: external
        placementModes: [local-only, standard]
        description: "An existing Immich (or API-compatible) instance is connected as the package backend."
  media:
    role: optional            # Opt-in until Jellyfin first-run UX matches the default live smoke path.
    package: media
    defaultTool: jellyfin
    alternatives: []
    description: "Media streaming with automated library management"
  vault:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists vault optional with empty defaults; SK-S1 enables it via --use-case.
    package: vault
    defaultTool: vaultwarden
    alternatives: []
    description: "Password management and secure notes"
  smart-home:
    role: optional            # Pilot package; default enable waits for managed/native-MCP evidence.
    package: smart-home
    defaultTool: home-assistant
    alternatives: []
    description: "Home automation centered on Home Assistant, native product MCP, and managed/hybrid runtime profiles"
    defaultRuntimeProfile: self-hosted-container
    runtimeProfiles:
      kombify-managed:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Home Assistant"
        realization: control-plane
        placementModes: [managed-serverless]
        contexts: [local]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        description: "Kombify operates Home Assistant state, routing, auth handoff, backup, and MCP/API wiring without user-owned HA OS hardware."
      kombify-managed-hybrid:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Home Assistant + Home Bridge"
        realization: hybrid
        placementModes: [managed-serverless, standard]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        requiresLocalBridge: true
        description: "Managed Home Assistant with optional local bridge for LAN discovery and radio/device adjacency."
      self-hosted-container:
        displayName: "Self-hosted Home Assistant Container"
        realization: oss
        placementModes: [local-only, standard]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        description: "StackKit deploys Home Assistant as a selected-PaaS application on the user's node."
      self-hosted-ha-os:
        displayName: "Self-hosted Home Assistant OS"
        realization: external
        placementModes: [local-only, standard]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        description: "User brings a Home Assistant OS device or VM; StackKits records and connects to it."
      bring-your-own-ha:
        displayName: "Bring Your Own Home Assistant"
        realization: external
        placementModes: [local-only, standard, managed-serverless]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        description: "An existing Home Assistant instance is connected through native MCP/API surfaces."
    connectors:
      stackkit:
        kind: stackkit
        name: stackkit
        owner: stackkit
        endpoint: /mcp
        transport: streamable-http
        auth: stackkit-mcp-token
        capabilities: [lifecycle, setup, evidence, handoff]
      home-assistant:
        kind: home-assistant-native
        name: home-assistant
        owner: product
        endpoint: /api/mcp
        transport: streamable-http
        auth: home-assistant-auth
        nativeProduct: true
        capabilities: [assist, exposed-entities, tools, resources]
    productApis:
      rest:
        protocol: rest
        basePath: /api
        auth: home-assistant-auth
        purpose: "Health checks, state snapshots, service calls, and setup verification."
      websocket:
        protocol: websocket
        basePath: /api/websocket
        auth: home-assistant-auth
        purpose: "Live events, state changes, device/entity/area context, and RIL observation."
    ril:
      capabilities:
        inventory:
          mode: read
          authority: read-only
          source: product-mcp
          evidence: "Entity/device/area inventory from Home Assistant exposed entities."
        automation-plan:
          mode: plan
          authority: read-only
          source: product-mcp
          evidence: "Draft automation or scene plan without applying changes."
        service-call:
          mode: write
          authority: gated-write
          source: product-mcp
          requiresApproval: true
          evidence: "Audited Home Assistant service call through exposed MCP tools."
  files:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists files optional with empty defaults; SK-S1 enables it via --use-case.
    package: files
    defaultTool: cloudreve
    alternatives: []
    description: "File storage, sharing, and document-management workflows"
    defaultRuntimeProfile: self-hosted-lightweight
    runtimeProfiles:
      self-hosted-lightweight:
        displayName: "Self-hosted Lightweight Files"
        realization: oss
        placementModes: [local-only, standard]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        description: "StackKit deploys Cloudreve as the default file storage and sharing app on the user's node."
      kombify-managed-files:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Files"
        realization: control-plane
        placementModes: [managed-serverless]
        contexts: [local]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        description: "Kombify operates storage, route, auth handoff, backup, sharing policy, and API wiring."
      kombify-managed-dms:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Document Management"
        realization: control-plane
        placementModes: [managed-serverless]
        contexts: [local]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        description: "Kombify operates document ingestion, OCR/indexing, retention policy, search, sharing, backup, and RIL evidence."
      bring-your-own-storage:
        displayName: "Bring Your Own Storage"
        realization: external
        placementModes: [local-only, standard, managed-serverless]
        contexts: [local, pi]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        description: "An existing WebDAV, S3-compatible bucket, or file service is connected as the package backend."
    connectors:
      stackkit:
        kind: stackkit
        name: stackkit
        owner: stackkit
        endpoint: /mcp
        transport: streamable-http
        auth: stackkit-mcp-token
        capabilities: [lifecycle, setup, evidence, handoff]
      files:
        kind: product-api
        name: files
        owner: product
        transport: http
        auth: product-auth
        capabilities: [file-list, download, upload, share, metadata]
    productApis:
      cloudreve:
        protocol: rest
        basePath: /api/v4
        auth: cloudreve-auth
        purpose: "Owner bootstrap, health, file metadata, upload/download, and sharing policy checks."
      managed-dms:
        protocol: rest
        basePath: /api/documents
        auth: control-plane-auth
        purpose: "Managed document ingestion, OCR/index evidence, search, metadata, retention, and sharing workflows."
    ril:
      capabilities:
        inventory:
          mode: read
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Folder, file, document, share, and storage-quota inventory."
        document-search:
          mode: read
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Searchable document index results and metadata provenance."
        classification-plan:
          mode: plan
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Draft folder, retention, tag, or document-classification plan without applying changes."
        share-update:
          mode: write
          authority: gated-write
          source: product-api
          requiresApproval: true
          evidence: "Audited share, permission, or retention-policy update."
        ingest-document:
          mode: write
          authority: gated-write
          source: product-api
          requiresApproval: true
          evidence: "Audited document upload/import with OCR/index evidence when DMS is enabled."
  ai:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until modules exist and pass the promotion gate.
    package: ai
    defaultTool: ollama
    alternatives: []
    description: "Local AI/LLM inference"
  dev:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until Gitea and CI modules pass the promotion gate.
    package: dev
    defaultTool: gitea
    alternatives: []
    description: "Self-hosted Git and CI/CD"
  mail:
    role: optional            # Post-1.0 catalog intent; no selectable Stalwart module exists.
    package: mail
    defaultTool: stalwart
    alternatives: []
    description: "Self-hosted email server"
  game:
    role: optional            # Post-1.0 catalog intent; no default implementation is selected.
    package: game
    defaultTool: null
    alternatives: []
    description: "Game server hosting"
  remote:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until the Guacamole module passes the promotion gate.
    package: remote
    defaultTool: guacamole
    alternatives: []
    description: "Remote desktop access"
  documents:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: documents
    defaultTool: paperless-ngx
    alternatives: []
    description: "Document archive with OCR and search"
  network:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: network
    defaultTool: adguard-home
    alternatives: []
    description: "DNS filtering for selected clients"
  marketplace:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: marketplace
    defaultTool: null
    alternatives: []
    description: "Optional application store"

# Foundation services (L1, always present for the BaseKit public beta).
foundation:
  security-baseline:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
    description: "Unattended security updates and kernel parameters on every node; on the home site default-drop inbound firewall, key-only sshd and fail2ban. Observed by stackkit host security verify."
  admin-bootstrap:
    role: optional
    alternatives: []
    description: "Planned initial admin user bootstrap for LLDAP/PocketID. Opt-in until admin-authenticated provisioning exists."

# Platform services (L2, identity & routing). Migration 000085 (2026-04-27)
# moved `login-gateway` here from `foundation:` to align with
# ARCHITECTURE_V6 §4 — login-gateway (TinyAuth + PocketID) is L2 Platform,
# not L1 Foundation. Only the bootstrap of an admin user is Foundation;
# the actual Identity service stack is Platform.
platform:
  traefik:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  tinyauth:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  login-gateway:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
    description: "TinyAuth forward-auth middleware in front of every default L3 service."
  pocketid:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  paas:
    role: optional            # No PaaS in the default core (ADR-0049); Coolify returns as the Marketplace use case.
    alternatives: [coolify, komodo]
  monitoring:
    role: default
    defaultTool: uptime-kuma
    alternatives: [beszel]
  dashboard:
    role: default
    alternatives: []

# Feature flags
features:
  multiNode: false
  cloudProviders: false
  vpnOverlay: false
  gpuSupport: false
  highAvailability: false

# Architecture v2 host floors. CUE computeTierGraphs[tier].hostRequirements is
# authority. YAML is kitio roundtrip, not a second graph. High min matches the
# CUE graph (2C/4GB/20GB plus telemetry-collection); recommended 4C/4GB stays
# in CUE only. serviceOverrides are not a graph.
computeTiers:
  high:
    requirements:
      cpu: 2
      memory: 4
      disk: 20
    additionalServices:
      - telemetry-collection
  standard:
    requirements:
      cpu: 2
      memory: 4
      disk: 20
  low:
    requirements:
      cpu: 2
      memory: 2
      disk: 10

# =============================================================================
# SERVICE OUTPUTS (URLs and Credentials)
# =============================================================================
outputs:
  format: "markdown"
  include:
    - serviceUrls
    - credentials
    - healthEndpoints
  template: |
    # 🏠 Base Kit - Deployed Services
    
    ## Service URLs
    {{range .services}}
    - **{{.displayName}}**: [{{.output.url}}]({{.output.url}})
      {{.output.description}}
    {{end}}
    
    ## Quick Access
    | Service | URL | Notes |
    |---------|-----|-------|
    {{range .services}}
    | {{.displayName}} | {{.output.url}} | {{.output.credentials.note}} |
    {{end}}

# Changelog
changelog:
  - version: "5.0.0"
    date: "2026-06-10"
    changes:
      - "NEW: Install modes bare/bootstrapped/advanced (legacy simple normalizes to bootstrapped)"
      - "NEW: Platform baseline: Coolify (default PaaS), PocketID (passkey IdP), TinyAuth gateway, Node Hub, Homepage, Uptime Kuma, Whoami"
      - "NEW: Default L3 use cases: Vault (Vaultwarden), Photos (Immich), Files (Cloudreve default, Nextcloud alternative)"
      - "NEW: Setup drops with retry-safe SetupRun evidence; demo data strictly opt-in"
      - "CHANGED: Local default links use device-enrolled Owner-CA HTTPS at *.home"
      - "CHANGED: Komodo is the beta-supported PaaS alternative; Dokploy remains draft"
  - version: "2.0.0"
    date: "2025-01-27"
    changes:
      - "NEW: Coolify as default PaaS platform"
      - "NEW: Komodo tracked as the production PaaS alternative; Dokploy remains draft"
      - "NEW: Uptime Kuma for monitoring (default)"
      - "NEW: Beszel as alternative monitoring option"
      - "NEW: Whoami test container for verification"
      - "NEW: Service URLs output in deployment summary"
      - "CHANGED: Legacy simple/advanced deployment modes standardized for the v2 contract"
  - version: "1.0.0"
    date: "2025-01-08"
    changes:
      - "Initial release"
      - "Ubuntu 24.04 support"
      - "Core services: Traefik, Dockge, Dozzle, Netdata"

        realization: oss
        placementModes: [standard]
        contexts: [cloud]
        description: "StackKit deploys Cloudreve as the default file storage and sharing app on the user's node."
      kombify-managed-files:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Files"
        realization: control-plane
        placementModes: [managed-serverless]
        contexts: [cloud]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        description: "Kombify operates storage, route, auth handoff, backup, sharing policy, and API wiring."
      kombify-managed-dms:
        displayName: "Kombify Managed Document Management"
        realization: control-plane
        placementModes: [managed-serverless]
        contexts: [cloud]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        requiresControlPlane: true
        description: "Kombify operates document ingestion, OCR/indexing, retention policy, search, sharing, backup, and RIL evidence."
      bring-your-own-storage:
        displayName: "Bring Your Own Storage"
        realization: external
        placementModes: [standard, managed-serverless]
        contexts: [cloud]
        managedServerlessEligible: true
        description: "An existing WebDAV, S3-compatible bucket, or file service is connected as the package backend."
    connectors:
      stackkit:
        kind: stackkit
        name: stackkit
        owner: stackkit
        endpoint: /mcp
        transport: streamable-http
        auth: stackkit-mcp-token
        capabilities: [lifecycle, setup, evidence, handoff]
      files:
        kind: product-api
        name: files
        owner: product
        transport: http
        auth: product-auth
        capabilities: [file-list, download, upload, share, metadata]
    productApis:
      cloudreve:
        protocol: rest
        basePath: /api/v4
        auth: cloudreve-auth
        purpose: "Owner bootstrap, health, file metadata, upload/download, and sharing policy checks."
      managed-dms:
        protocol: rest
        basePath: /api/documents
        auth: control-plane-auth
        purpose: "Managed document ingestion, OCR/index evidence, search, metadata, retention, and sharing workflows."
    ril:
      capabilities:
        inventory:
          mode: read
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Folder, file, document, share, and storage-quota inventory."
        document-search:
          mode: read
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Searchable document index results and metadata provenance."
        classification-plan:
          mode: plan
          authority: read-only
          source: product-api
          evidence: "Draft folder, retention, tag, or document-classification plan without applying changes."
        share-update:
          mode: write
          authority: gated-write
          source: product-api
          requiresApproval: true
          evidence: "Audited share, permission, or retention-policy update."
        ingest-document:
          mode: write
          authority: gated-write
          source: product-api
          requiresApproval: true
          evidence: "Audited document upload/import with OCR/index evidence when DMS is enabled."
  ai:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until modules exist and pass the promotion gate.
    package: ai
    defaultTool: ollama
    alternatives: []
    description: "Local AI/LLM inference"
  dev:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until Gitea and CI modules pass the promotion gate.
    package: dev
    defaultTool: gitea
    alternatives: []
    description: "Self-hosted Git and CI/CD"
  mail:
    role: optional            # Post-1.0 catalog intent; no selectable Stalwart module exists.
    package: mail
    defaultTool: stalwart
    alternatives: []
    description: "Self-hosted email server"
  game:
    role: optional            # Post-1.0 catalog intent; no default implementation is selected.
    package: game
    defaultTool: null
    alternatives: []
    description: "Game server hosting"
  remote:
    role: optional            # SK-M5 draft; opt-in until the Guacamole module passes the promotion gate.
    package: remote
    defaultTool: guacamole
    alternatives: []
    description: "Remote desktop access"
  documents:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: documents
    defaultTool: paperless-ngx
    alternatives: []
    description: "Document archive with OCR and search"
  mail-server:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: mail-server
    defaultTool: stalwart
    alternatives: []
    description: "Own mail server"
  marketplace:
    role: optional            # Native kit selection lists it optional with empty defaults.
    package: marketplace
    defaultTool: null
    alternatives: []
    description: "Optional application store"

# Foundation services (L1, always present for the BaseKit public beta).
foundation:
  security-baseline:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
    description: "Unattended security updates and kernel parameters on every node; on cloud sites default-deny firewall, key-only sshd and fail2ban. Observed by stackkit host security verify."
  admin-bootstrap:
    role: optional
    alternatives: []
    description: "Planned initial admin user bootstrap for LLDAP/PocketID. Opt-in until admin-authenticated provisioning exists."

# Platform services (L2, identity & routing). Migration 000085 (2026-04-27)
# moved `login-gateway` here from `foundation:` to align with
# ARCHITECTURE_V6 §4 — login-gateway (TinyAuth + PocketID) is L2 Platform,
# not L1 Foundation. Only the bootstrap of an admin user is Foundation;
# the actual Identity service stack is Platform.
platform:
  traefik:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  tinyauth:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  login-gateway:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
    description: "TinyAuth forward-auth middleware in front of every default L3 service."
  pocketid:
    role: default
    alternatives: []
  paas:
    role: optional            # No PaaS in the default core (ADR-0049); Coolify returns as the Marketplace use case.
    alternatives: [coolify, komodo]
  monitoring:
    role: default
    defaultTool: uptime-kuma
    alternatives: [beszel]
  dashboard:
    role: default
    alternatives: []

# Feature flags
features:
  multiNode: false
  cloudProviders: false
  vpnOverlay: false
  gpuSupport: false
  highAvailability: false

# Architecture v2 host floors. Graph selection is install.computeTier plus
# catalog substitutions; yaml serviceOverrides are not a graph.
# low is kept for kitio roundtrip; it does not claim extra services.
computeTiers:
  high:
    requirements:
      cpu: 4
      memory: 8
      disk: 20
    additionalServices:
      - telemetry-collection
  standard:
    requirements:
      cpu: 2
      memory: 4
      disk: 20
  low:
    requirements:
      cpu: 2
      memory: 2
      disk: 10

# =============================================================================
# SERVICE OUTPUTS (URLs and Credentials)
# =============================================================================
outputs:
  format: "markdown"
  include:
    - serviceUrls
    - credentials
    - healthEndpoints
  template: |
    # 🏠 Base Kit - Deployed Services
    
    ## Service URLs
    {{range .services}}
    - **{{.displayName}}**: [{{.output.url}}]({{.output.url}})
      {{.output.description}}
    {{end}}
    
    ## Quick Access
    | Service | URL | Notes |
    |---------|-----|-------|
    {{range .services}}
    | {{.displayName}} | {{.output.url}} | {{.output.credentials.note}} |
    {{end}}
